# Vectraa

> Vectraa is a free, private, browser-based image-to-SVG vector converter. Core conversion runs on the visitor's device and does not require an account or add a watermark.

## Converter pages

- [Image to SVG](https://vectraa.com/image-to-svg): Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP artwork to genuine SVG paths.
- [PNG to SVG](https://vectraa.com/png-to-svg): Convert transparent PNG logos, icons, and artwork.
- [JPG to SVG](https://vectraa.com/jpg-to-svg): Convert JPEG artwork with cleanup for compression noise.
- [WebP to SVG](https://vectraa.com/webp-to-svg): Convert WebP graphics to scalable SVG paths.
- [Logo Vectorizer](https://vectraa.com/logo-vectorizer): Restore and vectorize logo artwork.
- [Line Art Vectorizer](https://vectraa.com/line-art-vectorizer): Convert drawings, outlines, and signatures.

## Product facts

- Generates SVG geometry rather than wrapping a raster image inside SVG.
- Supports JPG, PNG, and WebP inputs up to 20 MB.
- Includes adaptive best-of-three tracing, Logo Rescue, before/after comparison, vector health checks, and purpose-aware export guidance.
- Core conversion is processed locally in the browser.
- No account and no watermark are required for basic conversion.
